Home.title: Ship the product, not the plumbing.
Home.description: Typed API boundaries, query state, forms, themes, translations and a complete frontend quality toolchain—already wired together.
Home.codePreviewLabel: Example of the typed API boundary
Home.codePreviewCaption: Every response is validated at runtime before it reaches the UI.
Home.stackLabel: Built on tools you already know
Home.stackDescription: Each layer owns one concern and exposes a typed contract to the next, so swapping a piece never means rewriting the app.
Home.apiDescription: An auth-ready Axios client with runtime Zod validation and a replaceable external API URL.
Home.clientDescription: TanStack Query, accessible UI primitives, dark mode and typed forms.
Home.qualityDescription: Vitest, Testing Library, Storybook, ESLint, Prettier, hooks and CI.
Home.i18nDescription: Locale-prefixed routing, type-checked message keys and SEO alternates for every page.
Home.designDescription: shadcn/ui primitives on semantic tokens with light, dark and system themes.
Home.performanceDescription: Core Web Vitals reporting, Lighthouse budgets, a strict CSP and hardened response headers.
Home.workflowTitle: From clone to product UI in three commands
Home.workflowDescription: Node.js 24 and pnpm 11 are the only requirements.
Home.stepInstallDescription: A single lockfile, a pinned package manager and no post-install surprises.
Home.stepSetupDescription: An interactive prompt sets the product identity, public origins and default locale.
Home.stepDevDescription: Mocks are enabled by default, so the Projects demo runs without a backend.
Home.ctaTitle: Clone it. Rename it. Start on the product.
Home.ctaDescription: The Projects page walks the full path from a validated form to a typed REST contract—search, sorting and pagination included.
Home.footerNote: Built with Next.js, React and Tailwind CSS.
